Definition: Whether ID system undergoes regular security audits, penetration testing, or vulnerability assessments
Comments: No evidence found of formal independent security audits or reviews of the STP ID system. The World Bank assessment notes the DGRN system lacks redundancy and business continuity measures, and recommends security improvements, but no completed independent security review has been identified. The World Bank Digital STP project includes a CSIRT (Computer Security Incident Response Team) establishment as a component but this is a future deliverable. Searched: STP ID system security review, DGRN audit, STP cybersecurity assessment.

revision_notes: Original score of 0/Unknown had no cited source, so a full check was run. A World Bank implementation-support mission aide-memoire for the Digital Sao Tome and Principe project (8-12 September 2025) confirms the National Cybersecurity Strategy and Action Plan (2024-2028) is still awaiting Council of Ministers approval and that the national CSIRT (CERT-STP) is not yet operational, with recruitment of technical staff and procurement of equipment only beginning around October 2025. No independent security audit, penetration test, or vulnerability assessment of the ID system itself has been conducted or documented. Recalculated from 0/Unknown to 1/No on the strength of this dated, authoritative evidence.
revised_comments: Sao Tome and Principe's identity system does not yet undergo regular independent security audits, penetration testing, or vulnerability assessments. A National Cybersecurity Strategy and Action Plan (2024-2028) has been drafted but awaits formal approval by the Council of Ministers, and the national Computer Security Incident Response Team (CERT-STP) remains in the process of being established, with recruitment of technical staff and procurement of tools only beginning in late 2025. No completed independent review of the digital ID system's security has been documented.
